meta.title: @tpcowork/dsh-browser
meta.description: Browser capability layer: connects web tools, visible sidebar pages and the Electron desktop bridge. Owns tab access, persistent logins, manual takeover, screenshots and downloads so the assistant and user share the same pages as an independently managed capability.

ui.bookmarksEmpty: No bookmarks yet. Import them from Chrome or Edge to open them here and from the address bar.
ui.bookmarksNotFound: No {browser} bookmarks were found. Make sure {browser} is installed and has been used.
ui.bookmarksUnreadable: The {browser} bookmarks file could not be read. Try again later.
ui.bookmarksSettingsHelp: Import bookmarks from Chrome or Edge to use them in the browser’s bookmark menu and address bar. They are read-only; importing again replaces them with the latest.
ui.title: Browser
ui.address: Enter a URL and press Enter
ui.empty: Paste or type a URL to open a page.
ui.unavailable: Browser is not ready. Install the matching desktop bridge and enable the plugin.
ui.settingsIntro: Sessions and workspaces in this application share website logins.
ui.importHelp: Import Chrome cookies and local storage. macOS may request Keychain access.
ui.clearConfirm: Clear all cookies, website storage and permissions? This closes browser pages and signs you out of websites.
ui.noPermissions: Allow or deny permissions when websites request them.
ui.importUnavailable: No data could be imported. Check that Chrome is installed and signed in.
ui.importDenied: Keychain access was denied. Retry the import or sign in here.
ui.resizeCorner: Resize browser viewport width and height
ui.resizeWarning: The browser size changed and may affect the current automated action
ui.insecureCertificatesHelp: When enabled, the built-in browser stops verifying HTTPS certificates. Affects the built-in browser only. Restart to take effect. Enable it only for trusted internal test sites.
ui.importSummary: Imported {cookies} cookies and {entries} LocalStorage entries from {origins} sites.
ui.importSummarySkipped: Imported {cookies} cookies and {entries} LocalStorage entries from {origins} sites; {skipped} cookies were not imported.
ui.importPartialStorage: Imported {cookies} cookies, but some LocalStorage data was not imported. Closing Chrome before retrying may improve the result.
ui.importNotFound: No importable Chrome profile was found. Open Chrome and make sure the profile contains browsing data.
ui.importNoChrome: Chrome was not found. Install Chrome and try again.
ui.importLocked: The Chrome profile is in use and a consistent snapshot could not be created. Close Chrome and try again.
ui.importProtected: Chrome cookies are protected by application-bound encryption and cannot be imported safely.
ui.importStorageFailed: The Chrome LocalStorage snapshot could not be read. Close Chrome and try again.
ui.insecureCertificatesRestart: Certificate setting saved. Restart the app to take effect.
ui.noSitePermissions: This site has not requested any permissions.
ui.loadErrorTitle: This page could not be opened
ui.certErrorTitle: This site's HTTPS certificate is not trusted
ui.certErrorHint: If you trust this address, enable "Ignore certificate errors" under Settings → Browser → Security, then restart the app to access it.
ui.invalidAddress: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS address
ui.importPromptTitle: Stay signed in to your sites
ui.importPromptIntro: Import cookies from Chrome so your sites open signed in, here and in every session.
ui.importPromptScope: Cookies and site data only. Passwords are never imported.
ui.importPromptProfile: Imports your most recently used Chrome profile. Clear it anytime in Settings.
